title: Joshua and Satan at the Court
description: The prophet Zechariah sees a heavenly trial where the high priest Joshua stands before the angel of the Lord in filthy clothes while Satan accuses him. The Lord rebukes Satan, removes Joshua's sin, and clothes him in festive garments with a clean turban. The angel of the Lord promises that if Joshua walks in the ways of the Lord, he will govern God's house. The Lord also announces that He will send His servant Branch to remove the land's sin in one day.
